title: Spec-conformance: linear-depletion emission deviates from story-018 (active stakers receive ~63.26% of intended; budget never depletes)
description: Law-2 faithfulness cross-reference of M-01. Story-018 specifies a linear-depletion reward schedule that delivers the full budget over the depletion window. The implementation re-spreads the entire remaining budget across a fresh full window on every interaction (_recomputeSchedule / _syncBudget), so the schedule deviates from the story: active stakers receive only ~63.26% of the intended emission (~37% shortfall) and the budget asymptotically never depletes. Because this deviation also carries a value-delivery impact, it is ALSO tracked as Medium M-01 per Law 1; this F-18-01 entry is its faithfulness cross-reference in spec-conformance.md.
impact: Story-018's linear-depletion intent is not faithfully delivered. Value impact (under-earning + undepleted budget) is carried by M-01 at Medium; solvency-safe.
recommendation: See M-01: anchor the depletion schedule to a fixed window so the budget is delivered on the story-018 schedule.
